title: Classic German Bratwurst
description: A traditional German dish featuring grilled bratwurst sausage served with a side of soft pretzels. This recipe is perfect for a casual dinner or weekend gathering.

ingredients.name: Bratwurst Sausage
ingredients.notes: You can find bratwurst sausage at most German or specialty grocery stores

ingredients.name: Soft Pretzel Buns
ingredients.notes: You can also make your own pretzel buns from scratch

ingredients.name: Caramelized Onions
ingredients.notes: Slice the onion thinly and cook it in a pan with some oil until it's caramelized and sweet

ingredients.name: German-Style Mustard
ingredients.notes: You can find German-style mustard at most grocery stores or make your own

ingredients.name: Chopped Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Sprinkle chopped parsley on top of the bratwurst for added flavor

ingredients.name: Bun-Sized Sauerkraut
ingredients.notes: You can find sauerkraut at most grocery stores or make your own

instructions: Season the bratwurst with salt and pepper.
Grill the bratwurst for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F.
Meanwhile, toast the pretzel buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Slice the bratwurst and serve on the toasted pretzel buns.
Top with caramelized onions, German-style mustard, and chopped parsley.
Serve with a side of bun-sized sauerkraut.
